description_en: Updates the basic information of multiple agents in a batch, excluding the skill information bound to the agents
description_zh: 批量更新座席基本信息，不包含座席绑定的技能信息的更新
name: CloudBatchUpdateAgent

parameters.help_en: The ID of the call center
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫中心 id
parameters.name: enterprise_id

parameters.help_en: The list of agent IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). You can update up to 100 agents at a time. Example: "0001,0002,00103". An agent ID is a positive integer of 3 to 10 digits
parameters.help_zh: 座席工号列表；需要批量更新座席的工号列表，多个之间使用英文标点逗号间隔，最多支持100个座席的批量更新。例如："0001,0002,00103"；座席工号，正整数，取值3-10位数字
parameters.name: cnos

parameters.help_en: The name of the agent. The value must be URL-encoded in UTF-8 format
parameters.help_zh: 座席姓名；需进行UTF-8格式的URLEncode编码
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The area code of the agent
parameters.help_zh: 座席所属区号
parameters.name: area_code

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the agent is activated. Valid values:
0: Not activated.
1: Activated.
Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 是否激活；取值0或1，取值说明 0：不激活，1激活，默认激活
parameters.name: active

parameters.help_en:
The type of the agent. Valid values:
1: Phone agent.
2: Computer agent.
Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 座席类型；取值1或2，取值说明 1：电话座席，2：电脑座席，默认电话座席
parameters.name: agent_type

parameters.help_en:
The role of the agent. Valid values:
1: Supervisor.
0: Regular agent.
Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 座席权限；取值1或0，取值说明 1：班长席，0：普通座席，默认为0 普通座席
parameters.name: power

parameters.help_en:
The call permission of the agent. Valid values:
0: Unlimited.
1: Domestic long-distance calls.
2: Domestic local calls.
3: Internal calls.
Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫权限；取值说明 0：无限制，1：国内长途，2：国内本市，3：内部呼叫，默认无限制
parameters.name: call_power

parameters.help_en: The wrap-up time in seconds. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 整理时间；单位秒数，默认10秒
parameters.name: wrapup

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether outbound calls are allowed. Valid values:
0: Not allowed.
1: Allowed.
Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 是否允许外呼；取值说明 0：不允许，1：允许，默认允许
parameters.name: is_ob

parameters.help_en:
The caller ID display rule. Valid values:
1: Default.
2: Random.
3: By area code.
4: Dynamic caller ID.
Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 外显规则；取值：1:默认 2:随机 3:按区号 4 动态外显 ，默认值为1
parameters.name: ob_clid_type

parameters.help_en: The caller ID number. You can enter an enterprise trunk number or a configured customer-facing caller ID number. This parameter is required when ObClidType is set to 2 or 3
parameters.help_zh: 透传号码；可传入企业中继号码或设置好的客户侧外显号码，当obClidType值为2或3时必选
parameters.name: ob_clid

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use a random caller ID. Valid values:
0: No.
1: Yes.
This parameter is required when ObClidType is set to 4. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 随机外显；取值说明 0:否，1:是。当obClidType值为4时需要传值，默认值为0
parameters.name: is_random

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to record inbound calls. Valid values:
0: Do not record.
1: Record.
Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 呼入是否录音；取值说明 0：不录音，1：录音，默认录音
parameters.name: ib_record

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to record outbound calls. Valid values:
0: Do not record.
1: Record.
Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 外呼是否录音；取值说明 0：不录音，1：录音，默认录音
parameters.name: ob_record

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic speech recognition (ASR) transcription. Valid values:
0: Disabled.
1: Enabled.
Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启ASR转写；取值说明：0：不开启，1：开启，默认不开启
parameters.name: is_asr

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable agent quality checks. Valid values:
0: Disabled.
1: Enabled.
Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启座席质检；取值说明：0：不开启，1：开启，默认开启
parameters.name: is_quality_check

parameters.help_en: The caller ID properties. Example value: {"isMatchCapital":0,"areaCodeRule":1}. When ObClidType is set to 4, isMatchCapital specifies whether to match the provincial capital number (1: yes, 0: no), and areaCodeRule specifies the area code matching rule (1: agent area code, 2: customer number area code). Note: JSON-formatted data must be URL-encoded
parameters.help_zh: 外显属性；取值：{"isMatchCapital":0,"areaCodeRule":1}；obClidType=4时，isMatchCapital表示是否匹配省会号码，1是 0否，areaCodeRule表示区号匹配规则，1座席区号 2客户号码区号（注意：json格式数据需要URLencode）
parameters.name: ob_clid_property

parameters.help_en:
The URL type for the WebRTC softphone. Valid values:
0: Enterprise default.
1: Public domain name.
2: Leased line domain name.
3: Public IP address.
4: Leased line IP address
parameters.help_zh: webrtc软电话返回地址；取值说明：0：企业默认 1：公网域名 2：专线域名 3：公网IP 4：专线IP
parameters.name: webrtc_url_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the outbound caller ID memory feature. Valid values:
0: Disabled.
1: Enabled.
Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 外呼主叫记忆开关；取值说明：0：关闭 1：开启；默认开启
parameters.name: is_ob_remember

parameters.help_en: The remarks
parameters.help_zh: 备注
parameters.name: comment

parameters.help_en: The time period during which outbound calls are allowed. Format: 08:00,20:00
parameters.name: permit_ob_preview_time

Fail.description_en: The list of agent IDs for which the configuration information failed to be updated
Fail.description_zh: 座席配置信息修改失败的座席工号列表
Fail.title_en: 座席配置信息修改失败的座席工号列表
Fail.title_zh: 座席配置信息修改失败的座席工号列表

Success.description_en: The number of agents whose configuration information was successfully updated
Success.description_zh: 座席配置信息修改成功数量
Success.title_en: 座席配置信息修改成功数量
Success.title_zh: 座席配置信息修改成功数量
